Whistleblowing · Directive (EU) 2019/1937

EU Whistleblower Channel Kit: set it up, handle every report on time.

Every employer with 50 or more workers needs an internal reporting channel under the EU Whistleblower Directive. This kit helps you set it up properly and handle every report on time.

Notion template

Directive (EU) 2019/1937

What's in the kit

  • Channel Setup Checklist — 15 tasks with the article behind each one
  • Handlers & Roles — designated handler and deputy, impartiality and training
  • National Law Directory — law, external authority and retention rule for DE, AT, NL, BE, ES and HR
  • Case Register — automatic acknowledgement (7 days), feedback (3 months) and deletion dates
  • Whistleblowing policy template, ready to adapt and publish
  • Message templates — acknowledgement, questions, feedback and closing letters
  • Setup guide with confidentiality and data-protection tips, plus an FAQ

The rules it covers

  • Who needs a channel

    Private employers with 50 or more workers must set up internal reporting channels (Art. 8). Some sectors, such as financial services, must do so regardless of size.

  • Deadlines

    Acknowledge receipt within 7 days and give feedback within a reasonable time of no more than 3 months (Art. 9).

  • Confidentiality and protection

    The reporter's identity must stay confidential (Art. 16) and retaliation is prohibited (Art. 19). Records are kept only as long as necessary.

Made for

  • HR teams
  • Legal and compliance teams
  • Managing directors of companies with 50+ employees
  • Advisers who set up channels for clients

Questions about this kit

We have fewer than 50 employees. Do we need this?
Usually not under the directive, unless you work in financial services or another sector covered regardless of size. Some countries go further, so check the national law in the directory.
Can an external provider run the channel?
Yes. A third party can receive reports on your behalf, but the duties stay with you. The kit helps you document roles and deadlines either way.
Is there a Word or Excel edition?
Not yet. This kit is currently available as a Notion template only. The free Notion plan is enough: after purchase you click “Duplicate” and the kit is copied into your own workspace.
